title: Career Roadmap · Field Service Technician
summary: A Field Service Technician installs, inspects, repairs and maintains equipment at customer sites, diagnosing faults, completing service reports and helping customers operate technology safely and reliably.

facts.Current degree: ITI Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Solar / Drone / Smart Agriculture Technician

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for eligible ITI pathways; Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics can broaden diploma and engineering options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science is useful for advanced technical routes but is not mandatory for every vocational trade.

blocks.text: Electrical systems, electronics, mechanical components, sensors, tools and troubleshooting.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Logical thinking, basic mathematics, communication, safe tool handling and customer service.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Entry requirements vary by trade and institution. Check the current DGT CTS directory and relevant state admission notification before applying.
Government / Public — options to investigate

items.text: Government ITIs offering Electrician, Electronics Mechanic or relevant mechanical trades.
National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) offering technical CTS courses.
Government polytechnics offering electrical, electronics or mechanical diplomas.
Government engineering colleges with relevant technical programs.
Sector-specific training centres operated by equipment manufacturers or public-sector organizations, where available.

blocks.text: Private / Industry

Choose based on hands-on workshop facilities, equipment access, employer partnerships and supervised fault-finding practice. Confirm current courses and admissions through official institute websites.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Learn tools, equipment components, electrical/mechanical basics, safety and service documentation.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Practise installation, inspection, preventive maintenance and fault diagnosis under supervision.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: Handle customer-site troubleshooting, replacement parts, testing and service reports.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Build a service logbook, practise customer communication and prepare for technical interviews.
